title: Flatness, Menger curvature, and parametrization
summary: We show that on linearly locally contractible (LLC) manifolds, the beta numbers (which describe unilateral flatness) are comparable to the theta numbers (which describe bilateral flatness), quantitatively. As an application, we show that if $M\subset\mathbb{R}^n$ is a compact LLC $m$-manifold with finite Menger $p$-energy for some $p>m(m+2)$, then $M$ is in fact a $C^{1,α}$ manifold.
